svg.title: particle-physics-simulation
svg.desc: An ASCII Verlet simulation. A nozzle at the upper left of a round container fires a stream of particles that arc across, streaking as they fly, bounce off the wall, slide down and pile up at the bottom; their tone says how fast they move and the newest are red. Then the bottom opens, the pile pours out and the empty container is ready for the next run.
